item.title: Said & Checked, Montana, 2026-11-20: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Tim Sheehy)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Tim Sheehy, U.S. Senator: “It has taken the lives of thousands of Americans.” Unsettled. In the speech "It" is radical Islam and the Iranian regime over the past half-century. The official attributions found reach the hundreds, including at least 603 U.S. deaths in Iraq attributed to Iran-backed militants by the Pentagon in 2019, as reported by Military Times, so "thousands" depends on what is counted.

5 statements by 1 officeholder. 1 checked: 1 unsettled · 4 not checkable.
